## Change

Describe the problem, visible change and scope. Link any relevant issue.

## Verification

List checks actually run and the OS/hardware tested. Include a focused regression.
Do not claim native tests or long-running qualification from a short fixture run.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have the rights to submit this contribution under MPL 2.0.
- [ ] I preserved existing first-party and upstream license notices.
- [ ] No credentials, private configurations, charts or captures are included.
- [ ] Simulation state, bounded workers/queues and offline behavior are preserved.
- [ ] I described remaining test gaps and compatibility/migration effects.

Maintenance is best effort; submitting a contribution does not guarantee review
or acceptance within a particular time.
